div.font:
1) Host configures control registers and buffer addresses.
2) Input features are streamed from DDR to PL via DMA.
3) The 4-block compute chain runs frame by frame.
4) Output vectors are streamed back to DDR via DMA.
5) Host receives completion and starts post-processing.
